rationale: The bundled desktop home server explicitly supplies AWSXRayPropagator and never constructs JaegerPropagator; this exact unused transitive path remains only for upstream compatibility.
The bundled desktop home server supplies an explicit OTLP metric reader and does not install the Prometheus exporter, so the vulnerable built-in Prometheus listener is unreachable.
Metro is repository-controlled mobile build tooling; shipped application and server runtimes do not include or invoke this parser, and no patched image-size release currently exists.
